evidence: The report identifies com.hotack.silentsdk as a hidden, system-privileged boot-starting RAT/dropper that downloads and executes remote code via api.pixelpioneerss.com. An independent analysis of another projector independently classifies the same package as a RAT/dropper and maps the same C2. Source confirmation through 2026-06-18; no current liveness is claimed. Source: https://github.com/Kavan00/Android-Projector-C2-Malware. Independent source: https://zanestjohn.com/blog/reing-with-claude-code.
